defs.def: the particular way in which sth is done 方式；作风

ex.s: It tailors learning experiences to different age groups and learning styles.
ex.t: 它针对不同年龄段和学习风格量身定制学习体验。

ex.s: It analyzed different kinds of parenting styles.
ex.t: 它旨在提高孩子的学业成就。

ex.s: Being at the right place at the right time is decisive in any style of photography.

ex.s: Form and style.

ex.s: Performing in his own style.

defs.def: the features of a book, painting, building, etc. that make it typical of a particular author, artist, historical period, etc. 风格；体
the correct use of language 语言规范；好的文风
having the type of style mentioned 构成形容词
the long thin part of a flower that carries the stigma 花柱

defs.def: to design, make or shape sth in a particular way 把 … 设计（或缝制、做）成某种式样

ex.s: Features are written in an individual style, with extra detail and background.
ex.t: 特写文章以个性化的风格写成，带有额外的细节和背景。

ex.s: The style of the first paragraph also needs to set the tone of the whole piece.
ex.t: 第一段的语言风格也需要定下整篇文章的基调。

ex.s: There, they were welcomed to the Chinese-style compound where they were to live.
ex.t: 在那里，他们受到欢迎，入住一座中式庭院。

ex.s: His informal but sophisticated style of writing, in both Chinese and English, made him one of the most influential writers of his generation.
ex.t: 他无论中文还是英文都采用不拘一格却又精妙老练的文风，这使他成为同时代最具影响力的作家之一。

ex.s: Twain's particular style of writing is funny and often mischievous.
ex.t: 吐温独特的写作风格诙谐幽默，且常常带着点淘气。

defs.def: to give sb/sth/yourself a particular name or title 称呼；命名；称
